title: eunomia-bpf/agentsight eBPF boundary tracing and session observability study
observations: AgentSight uses eBPF uprobes on SSL_read/SSL_write and tracepoints on sched_process_exec/openat to trace agent intent and action at stable OS boundaries with <3% overhead.

The core userspace architecture is a unified MaterializedView that ingests normalized events and updates typed read-model rows (llm_calls, token_usage, audit_events, process_nodes, tool_calls, sessions, network_targets, resource_samples) with bounded in-memory retention.
Session-centric top reorients the monitoring primitive from raw OS process PIDs to agent sessions, aggregating tokens, tools, subprocess execs, failures, and file/net activity.
Agent-native session parsers (Claude, Codex, Gemini, Cursor) provide a zero-eBPF fallback and offline audit capability, normalizing disparate JSON/JSONL transcripts into a shared session model.
Token usage accounting implements priority-based merging (network response usage > stdout stats > native session logs) to avoid double-counting across overlapping telemetry sources.

This study is clean-room inspiration and selective adaptation under MIT license: eBPF kernel probes are outside FAK's pure-Go binary scope, but the session view model, token priority rules, Gemini session ingestion, and session-centric activity counters directly inform FAK's session and gateway observability.

candidates.outcome: Filed #10737 to implement token source priority hierarchy and deduplicating merge logic.

candidates.effect: Bounded in-memory materialized view row model for session observability with LRU detailed event eviction and monotonic counters.
candidates.outcome: Filed #10739 to implement bounded MaterializedView row model in internal/sessionview.

candidates.effect: Session-centric live monitor displaying aggregated tokens, tool calls, subprocess executions, failures, and file/net counts per agent session.
candidates.outcome: Filed #10740 to enrich fak ps/top with session tool, execution, failure, and effect activity counters.

candidates.effect: Agent-native Gemini CLI session parser and discovery for offline session audits.
candidates.outcome: Filed #10738 to add Gemini CLI chat JSON transcript parser and discovery to fak session-audit.

candidates.effect: Kernel-level zero-SDK SSL/TLS traffic interception via eBPF uprobes on SSL_read/SSL_write.
candidates.outcome: FAK operates as an in-process gateway and agent wrapper in Go; kernel-level eBPF uprobes require Linux root privileges and C/eBPF toolchain outside FAK's zero-dependency single-binary architecture.

candidates.effect: OpenTelemetry GenAI span export for LLM calls from session view rows.
candidates.outcome: Already tracked under existing FAK issue #9559 (feat(trajectory): export normalized attribution events as JSONL and OpenTelemetry); no duplicate ticket required.
